sop_name: Chain of Custody under the NDPS Act
objective: To maintain the integrity, authenticity and traceability of seized narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and associated evidence from the time of seizure until final disposal or production before the Court.

legal_basis.purpose: Preparation of inventory, photography, sampling and certification of seized narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances.
Safe custody of seized narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and related articles.
Reporting of arrest and seizure to superior officers.

procedure.title: Assign Evidence Identification
procedure.description: Assign a unique identification number to every seized exhibit immediately after seizure.

procedure.title: Document Evidence
procedure.description: Record description, quantity, packaging, identifying marks, seizure location, date, time and seizing officer.

procedure.title: Seal Evidence
procedure.description: Seal every exhibit using tamper-evident seals and record the seal impression in official documentation.

procedure.title: Prepare Inventory
procedure.description: Prepare inventory and photographic documentation in accordance with Section 52A of the NDPS Act.

procedure.title: Transfer to Safe Custody
procedure.description: Deposit seized material in the designated malkhana or authorized storage facility without unnecessary delay.

procedure.title: Record Every Transfer
procedure.description: Document every transfer of custody including officer names, designation, date, time, purpose and signatures.

procedure.title: Forward Samples
procedure.description: Forward representative samples to an authorized forensic laboratory with proper forwarding documents and seal verification.

procedure.title: Produce Before Court
procedure.description: Produce evidence before the competent Court whenever required while maintaining complete custody records.

procedure.title: Final Disposal
procedure.description: Dispose of seized narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances in accordance with judicial orders and applicable NDPS Rules.

officer_responsibilities: Verify seal integrity during every transfer.
Immediately report damaged or broken seals.
Ensure evidence remains secure until final disposal.
references: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985
NDPS (Seizure, Storage, Sampling and Disposal) Rules, 2022
Directorate of Forensic Science Services Guidelines
